title: When the Confession Breaks
author: Cyrus Vane
blurb: Vesper Underhill, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
